answer: Every identity parks an 80-credit bond in a tundra registry, where bonds decay. Each epoch a saffron beacon draws 10%; anyone drawn shows a pigment proof of work or loses 15 credits, and two misses burn the bond and freeze it 10 epochs. Filing starts at 55, rising 5 per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes spend 2,552,500 and lock 80,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented pigment proof used twice voids both; one honest filing costs 55, keeps full share.
